summary: First-person walkthrough tour of a high-floor New York City studio apartment, featuring the modern kitchen, bathroom, and an outdoor terrace with sweeping views of the Empire State Building.

people.description: A woman with dark hair tied back in a ponytail wearing a black leather jacket and dark pants, walking through the apartment.

quality.issues: Quick camera movements and occasional lens flare from the direct sun outside

moments.action: Camera pans across the renovated kitchen with white cabinets, dark countertops, and stainless steel appliances
POV shot showing the clean bathroom vanity and glass shower door
Woman walks through the glass door leading out onto the private brick balcony
good_for: the best part of the apartment
